title: NT Heatwave Hazard Plan - Northern Territory, Australia
organization: Department of Health / NT Health (DoH / NT Health)
landscapes: Urban, Rural, Household, Institutional, Mass Gatherings, Occupational, Tropical and Subtropical
description: This heatwave hazard plan outlines Northern Territory emergency management arrangements for extreme heat events, including heatwave risk, activation triggers, warning levels, preparedness, response, recovery, communication, vulnerable groups, health service actions, and roles and responsibilities for NT Health, NT Government agencies, functional groups, local councils, and health services.
